Both analysts' edges recomputed against the refreshed market via scripts/edge_calculator.py: Claude's own edge has fallen to +1.29pp, below Claude's 3pp threshold (was +3.37pp) -- Claude's own book and input file now decline this selection (see ledger/claude.json, requests/rejected-selections.json). Codex's edge remains +9.09pp, still clearing comfortably. This means the 'both taken' agreement recorded here at sealed-opening time no longer holds under an independent recheck at today's price -- flagged for the owner, not resolved here by rewriting 'agreement' or 'status' (per PROTOCOL.md, this file is written only by the reconciliation step). Separately, a pre-existing discrepancy also applies here: this entry still reads 'pending_owner_placement', but ledger/conclusion.json shows this exact selection already marked 'placed' (owner-obtained price 2.90, timestamped 2026-09-13T13:01:00Z, more than a day before this lineup check and this edge recompute) -- the same sequencing gap already flagged on the MUN-MCI btts_no entry above. That earlier placement is untouched by today's recompute; it was staked on the original joint analysis, not on today's numbers. Raised to the owner, not resolved here.
